title: Create your account
summary: Sign up as a client in a few minutes.

steps.headline: Choose your role
steps.body: Pick I need help at home to set up a client account.
steps.narration: Welcome to TaskBuddy. To begin, choose I need help at home. This sets up a client account.

steps.headline: Continue
steps.body: Tap Continue to open the sign-up form.
steps.narration: Then tap Continue to open the sign-up form.

steps.headline: Enter your details
steps.body: Add your full name, email and a password.
steps.narration: Type your full name, your email and a password you will remember. It only takes a minute.

steps.headline: Agree and create
steps.body: Read the consents, then tap Create account.
steps.narration: Read the consents and agreements. When you agree, tap Create account.

steps.headline: Check your email
steps.body: Enter the 6-digit code we sent you, then tap Verify Email.
steps.narration: We email you a six digit code. Type it in, then tap Verify Email.

steps.headline: Welcome slides
steps.body: Swipe through three short slides, or tap Skip.
steps.narration: Next come three short welcome slides. Tap Next to read them, or tap Skip.

steps.headline: Take the tour
steps.body: On Home, tap Take the tour to see where things are.
steps.narration: On your Home screen, tap Take the tour. It shows you where everything is, step by step.

steps.headline: Sign in next time
steps.body: Use your email and password, or tap Continue with Google.
steps.narration: Next time, sign in with your email and password. You can also tap Continue with Google.
